death.npc.hell_guard.name: 子阴鬼牙将
death.npc.hell_guard.attack_ask: 阴鬼牙将是守关鬼卒里的精锐，你现在只是一缕鬼魂，打输了会再死一次，再受一次死亡的惩罚。确定要攻击他吗？

chat_msg: 白无常发出一阵像呻吟的声音，当他发现你正注视著他的时候，瞪了你一眼。
白无常把长长的舌头伸出来，缓缓地舔了舔自己又白又长的手指。

steps.line: 白无常说道：喂！新来的，你叫什么名字？
白无常用奇异的眼光盯著你，好像要看穿你的一切似的。
白无常「哼」的一声，从袖中掏出一本像帐册的东西翻看著。
白无常阁上册子，说道：咦？阳寿未尽？怎么可能？
白无常搔了搔头，叹道：罢了罢了，你走吧。
一股阴冷的浓雾突然出现，很快地包围了你。

d/death/npc/wgargoyle.c.set chat_msg: in set: the closure (: this_object(), "random_move" :) is random_move()
d/death/npc/wgargoyle.c.function init: calls in set: death_stage's call_out(5) chain for the player who comes in, started anew by each arrival (owner D6: one round at a time; ES2 ran a second chain beside the first); not for a wizard (none here)
d/death/npc/wgargoyle.c.function death_stage: calls[0..4]: one line every 5 seconds while the player is still there (present(ob)), the last with reincarnate() and the move to REVIVE_ROOM (step reincarnate); owner Q2 (a): calls_hold, he does not wander off while they are pending

d/death/npc/bgargoyle.c.function death_stage: calls in set, as wgargoyle.c's, the lines in HIB, for a ghost (act condition ghost); one who is no ghost (a 游识 to him) hears 喂！阳人来阴间做什么？ five seconds on and is attacked (kill_ob(): npc_flag hunts_player and kill), and the chain ends

d/death/gateway.c.function valid_leave: world.json exit_rules death.gateway.no_return (always: south to the gate refused; NPCs walk it, as !userp(me) did)
